cohort: 7346 women who delivered at M.K.C.G Medical College Hospital, Berhampur, Odisha, India, between May and October 2021, of whom 150 (3.4%) were admitted to the HDU.
finding: The presence of a High Dependency Unit (HDU) was associated with a lower ICU admission rate (2.6%) and a lower maternal mortality ratio (4.8 per 1000 live births compared to 6.8 per 1000 live births without an HDU).
gest_age: Both term and preterm pregnancies were included, with term pregnancies experiencing more complications (66.6%).
followup_time: N/A - The study examined outcomes during the hospital stay, not long-term follow-up.
